query.description: query whose outer bindings each name a build

to.description: registered tool called for each changed binding

floor.description: earliest a scheduled reconciliation may run

immediate.description: reconcile when selected graph inputs change

wiring.description: output slot -> component.property -> sibling output slot; fills writable references before admission, overriding tool values

definition.description: fingerprint of the current template, effective using, wiring, tool and its revision; definition edits never invalidate outputs

builder.description: a query-to-tool transformation; content.body is its optional $var template and using chooses a model

via.description: what the write was made through

staged.description: A builder being tried on a few bindings: only `builder build` builds it. Removing the mark builds the rest once, and a binding already built under the same key is not asked again.

source.description: component:name or entity:eid read by an immediate builder

version.description: compare-and-set token for one dependency replacement

match.description: JSON outer entity-ID tuple; with the builder and variant, what the build's `build_of` key says

for.description: the entity it was built for: the first its outer binding holds, so a query reaches what was built for X (`.built.build.build.for=X`), which `match` as JSON cannot

key.description: opaque attempt key shared with its outputs; inputs select work, and an explicit reroll gets a fresh key

cost.description: the dollars its calls spent, summed: each call's own `cost` and the entries of each session a call opened; absent where none records any

inputs.description: fingerprint of the selected binding tree, independent of the builder definition

definition.description: definition fingerprint used by the latest attempt; retained across definition edits

outdated.description: the latest attempt used a different definition from the builder now; not a vanished binding and not a reason to build automatically

build.description: one stable instance of a builder for an outer query binding

build_of.description: the key a build is found by: `<builder>/<variant>/<match>`, so a rebuild lands on the build already there

output_of.description: the key of one take: <build>/<slot>/<call>, so replaying one answer keeps its entity and another answer adds a take

current.description: chosen take whose binding still matches its inputs; readers keep playing it while a reroll with unchanged inputs is pending

definition.description: definition fingerprint used to produce this output

inputs.description: binding fingerprint that produced this take

built.description: one retained take in one named output slot; chosen marks the one in use

builder_model.title: Model builder adapter
builder_model.description: Open a model session for one frozen builder binding

builder_build.title: Build now
builder_build.description: Build bindings with new or changed inputs, independent of floor and staged. Current outputs are untouched unless --rebuild redoes every selected binding, or --outdated redoes bindings under an older definition. Both combine with --only and --limit. Alternate provider, model, template or native input creates a shadow variant.

builder.description: id of the builder to build

provider.description: the provider to ask instead of the configured one

model.description: the model to build with instead of the configured one

template.description: alternate content.body template for a shadow variant

input.description: native request fields merged into using.input for a shadow variant; --input @input.json reads an object

only.description: build only the bindings whose outer entities these name, and leave the other builds as they are

limit.description: build only the first n bindings, and leave the other builds as they are

rebuild.description: redo every selected binding, even with unchanged inputs and definition

outdated.description: redo selected bindings only when their definition is older; otherwise build only missing or changed inputs

builder_open.description: build a builder whose floor has passed, unless its key is built; removing its staged mark builds it too

builder_edit.description: reconcile a builder after its definition changes

builder_ring.description: a wake fired on a builder: check whether it is due

builder_answer.description: validate a tool answer and write its named outputs

builder_model_answer.description: adapt a model session's reply to a builder tool output once its ask completes

builder_supply.title: Supply an existing artifact
builder_supply.description: Answer one binding's slot with an existing artifact, spending nothing. The binding is current until its own inputs change. A staged builder accepts supply; an archived builder does not.

for.description: the first entity in exactly one outer binding

args.description: provenance kept beside the frozen binding on the supplied call

via.description: what the write was made through

chosen.description: the take in use for its build and slot; server-owned, changed through builder_choose, with at most one choice per slot

builder_choose.title: Choose an output take
builder_choose.description: Make one retained output the take in use for its build and slot, without a call or spending. Other slots stay chosen as they are.
